scope: Exact binary/pure block component sets, not implicit binary endpoints of ternary blocks. DOI/block/property/point are jointly scoped identifiers. srd46.assessment: SRD-46 stores ligand pKa and metal-ligand equilibrium/stability constants. It has no density, viscosity, heat-capacity or thermophysical-property measurement table. The six Q1 prompts cannot be numerically validated against it. Shared solvent names and 25 C conditions are not equivalent observables. ThermoML raw entries are used instead.
